method: Each fix was reverted alone in a temporary copy of apps/safari-extension (plus packages/contracts and package.json); the unchanged round-2 tests were then run. A regression counts only if it fails without its fix and passes with it (see r2-edge-selftest.json / unit results). Desktop Edge 154 headless; synthetic events; the F4 case uses the self-test deferred transport, not a native bridge.
environment: Microsoft Edge 154.0.4258.37 headless on Windows 10.0.26200 via WSL2; Node 24.21.0; TypeScript 7.0.2

cases.reverted: early pointercancel handling removed (pending mouse text handled first, as in 127bd4c)
frame card relay accepted without a completed, authorized top ASK
adjust confirm re-reads live text and page version at confirm time
presentation generation check after the bridge await removed
frame captured_at taken from the wall clock after hashing
failing_tests: capture time is not shifted by a slow hash (F5)
selection time is taken before hashing; frame time is the snapshot time (F5)

cases.reverted: original eigenvector fixture text ("keeps its direction")
failing_tests: eigenvector fixture covers negative and zero eigenvalues (F6)

note_on_runs: Two of the first mutation runs (F3, F4) did not load the page (net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED from WSL localhost forwarding right after the port was reopened) and produced no report; they were rerun after a pause. The harness now retries such a refused load once and logs it.
